recentItems.title: 'Forgotten Island' makes historic Hollywood premiere at Lucas Museum in LA | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
'A WIN FOR ALL OF US'

DreamWorks' Filipino culture-inspired "Forgotten Island" held its Hollywood premiere at the newly opened Lucas Museum of Narrative Art on Wednesday (US time), making history as the first film to premiere at the museum.

In attendance were cast members Liza Soberano, H.E.R., Dave Franco, Jo Koy, and Manny Jacinto. Filipino co-director Januel Mercado, who also voiced Soberano’s father in the movie, walked the red carpet alongside co-director Joel Crawford.

"Forgotten Island" is now showing nationwide in the Philippines. — via Yong Chavez, ABS-CBN News
